title: Change usage of tvb_get_uintYY(..., ENC_XX_ENDIAN)
description:
229 files modified, with 1,022 insertions and 1,040 deletions (the difference is from removing the encoding parameter).

The replacements made:

- tvb_get_uint16(..., ENC_BIG_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_ntohs(...)
- tvb_get_uint24(..., ENC_BIG_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_ntoh24(...)
- tvb_get_uint32(..., ENC_BIG_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_ntohl(...)
- tvb_get_uint64(..., ENC_BIG_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_ntoh64(...)
- tvb_get_uint16(..., ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_letohs(...)
- tvb_get_uint24(..., ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_letoh24(...)
- tvb_get_uint32(..., ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_letohl(...)
- tvb_get_uint64(..., ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN) → tvb_get_letoh64(...)

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

changed title from Use of tvb_get_ntohs/tvb_get_letohs instead of tvb_get_uintYY(..., ENC_XX_ENDIAN) to Change usage of of tvb_get_uintYY(..., ENC_XX_ENDIAN)
changed title from Change usage of of tvb_get_uintYY(..., ENC_XX_ENDIAN) to Change usage of tvb_get_uintYY(..., ENC_XX_ENDIAN)

tvb_get_uintYY(....ENC_XX_ENDIAN...) is definitely useful for some protocols which can support little or big endian modes (by preference, or which way around some magic bytes read).

packet-oran.c is for a protocol that supposedly could be little endian. I really doubt it will ever happen, but I would choose tvb_get_uint16() for that protocol just to make that potential change easier.

I am conflicted about this - I like the idea of everyone knowing what network/host order is, that a half is 2 bytes and long is 4, but I admit that it often takes me an extra second when I see it to break it down..
I prefer the clarity of `tvb_get_uint16(..., ENC_BIG_ENDIAN)` to the terseness of `tvb_get_ntohs(...)`. Code is read many more times than it is written.
I wonder if compilers optimize the longer expression to eliminate the `if` when the encoding is a constant. Perhaps checking godbolt could illuminate that.
I agreed with Joackim this is a bad change. If anything we should change it the other way for better readabillity.

-                tvb_get_uint16(tvb, (offset+4+32+2), ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN),  /* Group ID*/
